MITRE Embedded Capture the Flag (eCTF)
opportunities.location: Worldwide (virtual; award ceremony at MITRE, Bedford, MA)
opportunities.eligibility: University, high school, and community college teams worldwide; semester-long challenge where teams design, build, then attack secure embedded systems

opportunities.title: CSAW Embedded Security Challenge (ESC)
opportunities.location: CSAW finals venues (Brooklyn, Abu Dhabi, Kanpur, Valence) and online
opportunities.eligibility: University students; the longest-running hardware security competition, focused on physical attacks, fault injection, and increasingly AI-driven automation
opportunities.field_requirements: Embedded systems, hardware exploitation, fault injection

opportunities.title: ISEA-ISAP CTF
opportunities.eligibility: Indian students; national cybersecurity competition with dedicated embedded systems/IoT security and reverse-engineering tracks

opportunities.title: MITRE Beaver Works Summer Institute (BWSI)
opportunities.location: MIT Lincoln Laboratory, Lexington, MA (US-based pipeline program)
opportunities.eligibility: US high school students (citizenship or permanent residency required); summer pipeline program covering JTAG/UART probing, side-channel analysis, and hardware trojans

opportunities.title: SEMICON India Hackathon
opportunities.eligibility: Indian students; chip design, AI-enabled manufacturing, and advanced verification, with mentors from KLA and Applied Materials
opportunities.field_requirements: Chip design, EDA flows, AI-enabled manufacturing

opportunities.title: ChipVerse (IEEE CEDA Bangalore)
opportunities.eligibility: Students; 24-hour VLSI and embedded systems hackathon

opportunities.title: Hardwired (Silicon VLSI Forum, PES University)
opportunities.eligibility: Students; CTF-style VLSI hackathon covering analog and digital design plus FPGA implementation, run by the university's VLSI forum
opportunities.field_requirements: Analog and digital VLSI design, FPGA implementation

opportunities.title: ChipCraft (Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education)
opportunities.organization: Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education

opportunities.title: FOSSEE Circuit Design & Simulation Hackathon
opportunities.organization: FOSSEE (IIT Bombay) with VSD and NIT Jamshedpur
opportunities.eligibility: Students; open-source EDA hackathon built around eSim, run in memory of Ratan Tata
opportunities.field_requirements: Circuit design, simulation, open-source EDA with eSim

opportunities.title: CHIPS Alliance GSoC Mentor Organization
opportunities.eligibility: Students and open-source contributors; recurring GSoC mentor organization for open-source ASIC/FPGA tooling (OpenLane, OpenROAD, Verible, Chisel, F4PGA), including AMD/Xilinx open FPGA tooling

opportunities.title: FOSSi Foundation GSoC Umbrella
opportunities.eligibility: Students and open-source contributors; umbrella organization for GSoC hardware and RISC-V community projects such as OpenPiton, CVA6/Ariane, and LLHD/CIRCT tooling
opportunities.field_requirements: RISC-V and open hardware contribution experience

opportunities.title: RISC-V International Student Contribution Tracks
opportunities.eligibility: Students and open-source contributors; open ISA ecosystem with recurring student contribution tracks - confirm the current year's GSoC participation before applying, since the list changes annually

opportunities.title: CSAW Applied Research Competition (ARC)
opportunities.location: CSAW finals venues (Brooklyn, Abu Dhabi, Kanpur, Valence)
opportunities.eligibility: University students; CSAW's best-paper track for already-published or camera-ready student security research, presented at CSAW Finals

opportunities.title: IEEE HOST (Hardware Oriented Security and Trust)
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate and graduate researchers; leading hardware-security conference covering hardware trojans, side channels, and IC trust

opportunities.title: CHES (Conference on Cryptographic Hardware and Embedded Systems)
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate and graduate researchers; the top IACR venue for embedded cryptography and side-channel/fault-attack research

opportunities.title: DAC and ICCAD Student Research Competitions (ACM SIGDA SRC)
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate and graduate researchers; poster-format student research competitions run at DAC and ICCAD for EDA and VLSI work
